mentions.name: Cohort-based coach app
mentions.description: A cohort-based coach application where people register with a commitment and aim to complete daily tasks. Participants can communicate with an AI about difficulties or feelings, and the AI helps maintain the cohort's group spirit.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a cohort-based coach application. People register with a commitment and aim to do daily tasks. Meanwhile, they can communicate with an AI for any difficulties or feelings that AI keeps the cohort spirit.

evidence.value: I am working on a cohort-based coach application. People register with a commitment and aim to do daily tasks. Meanwhile, they can communicate with an AI for any difficulties or feelings that AI keeps the cohort spirit.
